def set_rcparams():
    tab = Table.read('rcparams.txt', format='csv')
    for i in range(len(tab)):
        try:
            plt.rcParams[tab['key'][i]] = float(tab['val'][i])
        except ValueError:
            plt.rcParams[tab['key'][i]] = str(tab['val'][i])
    return
set_rcparams()

def accuracy(frac_err, threshold=0.1):
    """ Our function to determine accurate predictions

    Args:
        frac_errr (list): list of fractional errors
        threshold (float): fractional percentage of accuracy (preset to 0.1=10%)
    Returns:
        None
        
    """
    return sum(frac_err <= threshold) / len(frac_err)

# Then we will evaluate fractuonal error

def scatter_formatter(datatable, ax, fig, ticks, difference=False):
    """ Plotter for the 2D comparison scatter plots to evaluate success

    Args:
        datatable (pandas.DataFrame): combined DataFrame from above
        ax (matplotlib.Axes): axis on which to plot
        fig (matplotlib.Figure): figure for colorbar
        ticks (list): ticks for x and y axis on the figures
        difference (boolean): if set to True, it restricts the predictions to those with a fractional uncertainty below 25% = 0.25
    Returns:
        None
        
    """
    if difference != False:
        accurate = datatable.query("frac_err<0.25")['difference']
    else:
        accurate = datatable['difference']

    image = ax.hexbin("true_period", "period",  data=datatable, mincnt=1, vmax=50, rasterized=True)
    ax.plot([0, 30], [0, 30], "k--", label="1:1")
    ax.plot([0, 30*0.9], [0, 30], "r:",  label="90th percentile")
    ax.plot([0, 30], [0, 30*0.9], "r:",  label="90th percentile")
    ax.set(xlim=(0, 30), ylim=(0, 30))
    ax.set_yticks(ticks = ticks, labels=ticks, weight='bold')
    ax.set_xticks(ticks = ticks, labels=ticks, weight='bold')
    ax.set_xlabel('True Period (days)', weight='bold')
    ax.set_ylabel('Predicted Period (days)', weight='bold')
    ax.set_title(f'{100*accuracy(accurate, 0.1):.0f}% within 10%, {100*accuracy(accurate, 0.2):.0f}% within 20%', weight='bold')
    cbar1 = fig.colorbar(image, pad=0, extend='max',)
    cbar1.set_label(label='Number', weight='bold')

def plotter_scatter(datatable):
    tix = [0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30]
    fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize=(10, 16), layout='constrained')
    scatter_formatter(datatable, axs[0], fig, tix)
    scatter_formatter(datatable, axs[1], fig, tix, True)
    plt.show()
